text:
When an owner wants to **retain the hotel’s identity while gaining global distribution, loyalty, sales and technology**, the following soft-brand and collection options are commonly screened. Availability and commercial terms vary materially by country.

### Major global-chain collections

| Hotel group | Commonly considered brands | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **The Luxury Collection**, **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** | Luxury through upper-upscale; established independent hotels and conversions |
|  | **Series by Marriott** | Midscale/upscale portfolios that want to retain an existing regional brand; currently available in selected global regions |
|  | **Design Hotels** | Design-led independent hotels under a lighter, non-franchise affiliation model |
| **Hilton** | **LXR Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** | Luxury, upper-upscale and upscale respectively |
|  | **Outset Collection by Hilton** | Flexible upscale/boutique conversions; initially concentrated in the United States and Canada |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt** | Luxury/upper-upscale landmarks, neighborhood lifestyle hotels and destination resorts |
|  | **Unscripted by Hyatt** | Newer upscale, light-touch collection designed specifically for independent conversions |
| **IHG Hotels & Resorts** | **Vignette Collection** | Independent luxury and lifestyle hotels |
|  | **Noted Collection** | Premium collection introduced in 2026, beginning its rollout in Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Africa |
|  | **voco hotels** | Highly conversion-friendly premium brand, although generally more visibly branded than a classic soft brand |
| **Accor** | **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery**, **Handwritten Collection** | Luxury, upper-upscale and midscale/upscale; designed around flexible standards and preservation of individuality |
| **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Trademark Collection**, **Dolce Hotels and Resorts** | Luxury resorts, upper-midscale-and-above independents, and meetings/resort-oriented properties |
| **Choice Hotels** | **Ascend Hotel Collection** | Upscale independent, historic and resort conversions |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | **Radisson Individuals**, including **Premier**, **Boutique** and **Retreats** variants | Upscale through upper-upscale independent hotels and regional portfolios |
| **BWH Hotels** | **BW Premier Collection**, **BW Signature Collection** | Upscale and midscale/upscale independent hotels |
|  | **WorldHotels Luxury, Elite, Crafted, Distinctive and Backdrop** | Luxury, lifestyle, upscale and outdoor-oriented independent properties |

Marriott explicitly positions Luxury Collection, Autograph and Tribute as collection brands for independent hotels, while Series by Marriott permits qualifying owners to retain regional branding. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai))

Hilton’s Curio and Tapestry frameworks are designed to retain individual property character; LXR covers the luxury end, while Outset adds a more flexible upscale conversion option. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai))

Hyatt’s portfolio spans Unbound, JdV and Destination, with Unscripted providing an especially light-touch, conversion-focused upscale option. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/en-US/brands/hyatt-independent-collections?utm_source=openai))

IHG currently identifies Vignette as its luxury soft brand, has introduced Noted Collection in the premium segment, and also treats voco as a major conversion vehicle. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai))

Accor’s core collection ladder is Emblems, MGallery and Handwritten; Wyndham identifies Registry, Trademark and Dolce as its soft-brand conversion options. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai))

Choice’s Ascend, Radisson Individuals and BWH/WorldHotels are also frequent alternatives, particularly where their regional distribution strength is competitive. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai))

### Lighter affiliation alternatives

If the owner wants **less operating prescription than a chain soft brand**, the comparison set often includes:

- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**
- **The Leading Hotels of the World**
- **Small Luxury Hotels of the World**
- **Design Hotels**
- **WorldHotels**
- In suitable luxury resort or culinary cases, **Relais & Châteaux**

These are closer to membership, marketing and distribution affiliations than traditional franchises. They can preserve more independence, but may provide less brand recognition, loyalty contribution, procurement leverage or operating support than Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, IHG or Accor. Preferred, for example, expressly markets its platform as being designed for independent hotels, while LHW and SLH curate independent luxury properties. ([join.preferredhotels.com](https://join.preferredhotels.com/?utm_source=openai))

### Practical initial shortlist by asset type

- **Iconic luxury urban or resort:** Luxury Collection, LXR, Unbound, Vignette, Emblems, Registry Collection, WorldHotels Luxury, LHW or Preferred Legend.
- **Upper-upscale independent/boutique:** Autograph, Curio, MGallery, JdV, Tribute, Noted Collection, Radisson Individuals Premier or WorldHotels Elite/Crafted.
- **Upscale conversion with lighter standards:** Tapestry, Outset, Unscripted, Handwritten, Trademark, Ascend, Radisson Individuals or BW Premier Collection.
- **Midscale or regional portfolio conversion:** Series by Marriott, Handwritten, BW Signature Collection and selected Trademark or Radisson Individuals opportunities.
- **Destination resort:** Destination by Hyatt, Vignette, Curio, Registry Collection, Dolce, WorldHotels or Preferred.
- **Design-led independent:** Design Hotels, Autograph, MGallery, JdV, WorldHotels Crafted or SLH.

The final decision should be based less on the brand name alone and more on **market-specific reservation contribution, total fees, required PIP, name/signage retention, contract term and exit rights, owner control over design/F&B, loyalty penetration, territorial protection and whether the agreement is franchise, management or affiliation-only**. A brand that is powerful globally may contribute relatively little in a particular source market, while a smaller collection may outperform locally.
